mapper.select: SELECT p.*,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,i.ingredient_name_std, (SELECT ph.purchase_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph WHERE ph.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_from<=NOW() AND (ph.effective_to IS NULL OR ph.effective_to>NOW()) ORDER BY ph.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) current_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=p.ingredient_id WHERE s.supplier_type<>'DIRECT' AND p.supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id} AND p.supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND p.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} AND p.active_yn=#{active_yn} ORDER BY s.supplier_name,p.product_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product (supplier_id,ingredient_id,supplier_item_code,product_name,order_unit,package_qty,package_unit,base_qty,base_unit, minimum_order_qty,order_multiple_qty,tax_type,active_yn,user_id) VALUES (#{supplier_id},#{ingredient_id},#{supplier_item_code},#{product_name},#{order_unit},#{package_qty},#{package_unit}, #{base_qty},#{base_unit},COALESCE(#{minimum_order_qty},1),COALESCE(#{order_multiple_qty},1),#{tax_type},COALESCE(#{active_yn},'Y'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE supplier_product_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(supplier_product_id), ingredient_id=VALUES(ingredient_id), product_name=VALUES(product_name), order_unit=VALUES(order_unit), package_qty=VALUES(package_qty), package_unit=VALUES(package_unit), base_qty=VALUES(base_qty), base_unit=VALUES(base_unit), minimum_order_qty=VALUES(minimum_order_qty), order_multiple_qty=VALUES(order_multiple_qty), tax_type=VALUES(tax_type), active_yn=VALUES(active_yn), user_id=VALUES(user_id), mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history SET effective_to=DATE_SUB(#{effective_from},INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id} AND effective_to IS NULL AND effective_from < #{effective_from}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history (supplier_product_id,purchase_price,effective_from,effective_to,user_id) VALUES (#{supplier_product_id},#{purchase_price},#{effective_from},#{effective_to},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price_history_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(price_history_id), purchase_price=VALUES(purchase_price), effective_to=VALUES(effective_to), user_id=VALUES(user_id)
